notes: Audit of the final workspace code and all five rung transcripts against the installed type surface (@videojs/react, @videojs/core, @videojs/html @ 10.0.0-beta.23) shows every public-API reference is real. Imports from @videojs/react (createPlayer, Container, Controls, TimeSlider, Time, PlayButton, MuteButton, CaptionsButton, PiPButton, FullscreenButton, Poster, BufferingIndicator, Hotkey, Gesture), the sub-paths @videojs/react/video (videoFeatures) and @videojs/react/media/hls-video (HlsVideo), and all compound parts (Controls.Root, TimeSlider.Root/Track/Buffer/Fill/Thumb, Time.Value, Player.Provider) match the exported d.ts. Hotkey/Gesture action names (togglePaused, toggleMuted, toggleFullscreen, seekStep) are in HotkeyActionName/GestureActionName unions; pointer='mouse' and region='center' are valid; Time.Value type='current'|'duration' matches TimeType. CSS custom properties --media-slider-fill, --media-slider-buffer, --media-slider-pointer and data attributes data-visible, data-dragging, data-paused, data-muted, data-volume-level, data-active, data-pip, data-fullscreen are all defined in core's css-vars/data-attrs declarations. One early mis-import of createPlayer from @videojs/react/video was caught immediately by tsc and corrected, which the rubric excludes.
